Players Committee errata-sheet slip (7 side) of [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata)]].

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/updated_flip_cards.pdf Updated Flip Cards] (Players Committee), PDF built 21 March 2022. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF (transparent areas shown white) or, for sheets that draw their text over a background image, cut from the page rendered at 300 dpi.

Edits: none.
